pagedata.pyUsage: Use after adding a work object, reopening a work object, or starting a new flow.
pagedata.pyLabel: BPM engine API: check for assignment to perform
pagedata.pyMemo: BUG-290834 removed assignPage as steppage for step4 property-set
pagedata.pyDescription: Checks for assignments for the current user using the assignment page. If there are assignments this routine locks the work object and populates flow actions. The output page property currentUserHasOwner will equal true if the current user has an assignment for the work object.
pagedata.pyLabelOld: BPM engine API: check for assignment to perform
